name: graphify (code graph)
description: Installs the graphify (graphifyy) code-graph CLI via isolated system-wide pipx. Sets GRAPHIFY_OUT to a mounted cache dir and declares a lace mount so the deterministic tree-sitter index persists across rebuilds without polluting the working tree. Provisions a scoping aid, not a related-code guarantee: consumers must fall back to grep when the index is stale or absent.

version.description: graphifyy PyPI version to install (exact pin; pre-1.0, so no range). Passed to pipx as graphifyy==<version>.

installMcpServer.description: Register the graphify MCP server (query_graph, get_node, shortest_path) into the remote user's Claude config via 'claude mcp add'. Requires the claude-code feature; no-op with a warning if the claude CLI is absent.

installGitHook.description: Install a post-commit git hook running 'graphify update' for index freshness. Off by default: it adds latency to every commit.

index.description: graphify output dir (GRAPHIFY_OUT): the AST index cache plus graph.json/GRAPH_REPORT.md, redirected out of the working tree and persisted across rebuilds so 'graphify update' stays incremental
